sourceNote: The playback engine is a separate dynamic library inside the app (Contents/Frameworks/Libmpv.framework), so that it can be replaced with a build of your own, as the LGPL asks. It is linked from prebuilt libraries published by the MPVKit project (github.com/mpvkit), LGPL configuration; the exact files, with their hashes, are listed in Config/mpv-libraries.lock in the app's source, and each of MPVKit's build repositories names the upstream source release it was built from. An app signed by a developer only loads libraries signed by the same developer: after replacing the framework, sign the app again yourself (codesign --force --deep --sign - <app>). The audio conversion helper is built from FFmpeg's own release archive (its address and hash are in Config/ffmpeg-helper.lock) with the configuration in Scripts/build-ffmpeg-helper.sh, which the program also prints with -version; it can be replaced in the same way.
